title: Highest Confidence
description: Select the option with the highest confidence from multiple columns. Inputs are expected to be of the form [<<value>>, <<confidence_score>>].

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: List of the input columns to select from.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: If two columns; the result and confidence. If one column; [result, confidence].

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Select the option with the highest confidence from multiple columns. Inputs are expected to be of the form `[value, confidence_score]`. ## Migrated examples #### Selecting Highest Confidence Single Output ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - select.highest_confidence: input: - Col1 - Col2 - Col3 output: Highest Confidence ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | Col3 | | --- | --- | --- | | ['A', 0.79] | ['B', 0.77] | ['C', 0.99] |
##### Output Sample | Highest Confidence | | --- | | ['C', 0.99] |
#### Selecting Highest Confidence Two Outputs ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - select.highest_confidence: input: - Col1 - Col2 - Col3 output: - Item - Confidence ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | Col3 | | --- | --- | --- | | ['A', 0.79] | ['B', 0.77] | ['C', 0.99] |
##### Output Sample | Item | Confidence | | --- | --- | | C | 0.99 |
